app.title: LifeLink KH
app.tagline: Connecting blood donors with the people who need them
app.portalCardBody: Every open blood request, the donors who accepted it, and the one write this portal has — confirming a donation.
app.adminCardBody: Grant portal access to hospital staff and administrators.

signIn.title: Staff sign-in
signIn.intro: This portal is for hospital staff and administrators. Donors and requesters use the mobile app.
signIn.noSelfSignup: There is no self sign-up. An administrator creates portal accounts.
signIn.rememberHint: Your password is not stored here — let your browser save it when it offers.
signIn.failedRateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
signIn.failedUnreachable: Cannot reach the server. Check that the backend is running.

password.title: Change password
password.intro: Changing the password for the account you are signed in as.
password.failedWrongCurrent: That is not your current password.
password.failedMismatch: The two new passwords do not match.
password.failedUnchanged: The new password must be different from the current one.
password.noteOtherSessions: Sessions already signed in elsewhere stay valid until they expire — there is no remote sign-out.

time.hours: {count, plural, =1 {1 hour ago} other {# hours ago}}

portal.title: Open requests
portal.unreachable: Could not load the request list.
portal.confirmFailed: Could not confirm that donation. It may already be confirmed.
portal.confirmDialogBody: This records that '{name}' donated blood on '{date}'. This cannot be undone.
portal.searchPlaceholder: Search by hospital or blood type

admin.title: Manage staff
admin.adminsOnly: This page is for administrators only.
admin.promoteFailed: Could not grant access. Check the details and try again.
admin.promoteHint: Only people who have already signed in to the app once can be promoted — pick them by name, not by typing an email.
admin.candidateHint: Choose who to grant access to
admin.noCandidates: Nobody has signed in yet who could be promoted.
admin.adminNoHospital: An admin sees every hospital, so there is no hospital to choose.
admin.createHint: For staff who do not use the mobile app — they sign in with a username and password.
admin.createFailedTaken: That username is already in use.
admin.createFailed: Could not create the account. Check the details and try again.
admin.revokeDialogBody: '{name}' will lose access to the portal. An account that also uses the mobile app keeps working there as an ordinary donor.
admin.demoteDialogBody: '{name}' will become hospital staff and will only see one hospital's requests. Choose which.
admin.actionFailedSelf: You cannot change your own access. Ask another administrator.
admin.actionFailedLastAdmin: This is the only administrator. Grant another one first.
admin.actionFailed: Could not complete that. Try again.
